```{r}
#| label: inject-dvf-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (dvf_ready) {
  # Colonnes (pas de lignes) : pm_<type>_<annee> et n_<type>_<annee>, 1 ligne / commune
  dvf_wide <- dvf_nested |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = code, names_from = c(type, annee),
                       values_from = c(pm, n), names_sep = "_")
  dvf_breaks_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(dvf_breaks, auto_unbox = FALSE)
  emit_table("dvfWide", dvf_wide)

  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.dvfBreaks = ', as.character(dvf_breaks_json), ';\n',
      'window.dvfPalette = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(PAL$green)), ';\n',
      'window.dvfDiv = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(PAL$div)), ';\n',
      '// Indexer : window.dvfData[code][type][annee] = {pm, n}\n',
      'window.dvfData = {};\n',
      'Object.keys(window.dvfWide).forEach(function(code) {\n',
      '  var r = window.dvfWide[code], o = {};\n',
      '  ["Appartement", "Maison"].forEach(function(t) {\n',
      '    [2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025].forEach(function(y) {\n',
      '      var pm = r["pm_" + t + "_" + y];\n',
      '      if (pm != null) { (o[t] = o[t] || {})[y] = { pm: pm, n: r["n_" + t + "_" + y] }; }\n',
      '    });\n',
      '  });\n',
      '  if (Object.keys(o).length) window.dvfData[code] = o;\n',
      '});\n',
      '// Panneau DVF\n',
      'window.updateDvfPanel = function(code) {\n',
      '  var el = document.getElementById("dvf-content");\n',
      '  if (!el) return;\n',
      '  var entries = window.dvfData[code];\n',
      '  var elecInfo = window.communeLookup && window.communeLookup[code];\n',
      '  var alt      = window.communeNames && window.communeNames[code];\n',
      '  var nom  = elecInfo ? elecInfo.nom_commune : (alt ? alt.nom : code);\n',
      '  var dept = elecInfo ? (elecInfo.libelle_dept + " (" + elecInfo.code_dept + ")") : (alt ? ("Dépt " + alt.dept) : "");\n',
      '  if (!entries) {\n',
      '    el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div><div class="dvf-empty">Pas de transaction publiée (mono-local, App/Maison) sur 2021-2025.</div>\';\n',
      '    return;\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  var years = [2021,2022,2023,2024,2025];\n',
      '  function trendBar(type) {\n',
      '    var ent = entries[type];\n',
      '    if (!ent) return "<div class=\\"dvf-trend-empty\\">Pas de " + type.toLowerCase() + "</div>";\n',
      '    var vals = years.map(function(y){return ent[y] ? ent[y].pm : null;});\n',
      '    var maxV = Math.max.apply(null, vals.filter(function(v){return v!=null;}));\n',
      '    if (maxV <= 0 || !isFinite(maxV)) return "<div class=\\"dvf-trend-empty\\">Pas de " + type.toLowerCase() + "</div>";\n',
      '    var bars = years.map(function(y,i){\n',
      '      var v = vals[i];\n',
      '      var h = v ? Math.round(v / maxV * 100) : 0;\n',
      '      var lbl = v ? Math.round(v).toLocaleString("fr-FR") : "—";\n',
      '      var nb = (ent[y] && ent[y].n) || 0;\n',
      '      return "<div class=\\"dvf-bar-col\\"><div class=\\"dvf-bar-vert\\"><div class=\\"dvf-bar-fillv\\" style=\\"height:" + h + "%;\\" title=\\"" + lbl + " €/m² · " + nb + " ventes\\"></div></div><div class=\\"dvf-bar-y\\">" + (y === 2025 ? "2025*" : y) + "</div><div class=\\"dvf-bar-val\\">" + lbl + "</div></div>";\n',
      '    }).join("");\n',
      '    return "<div class=\\"dvf-trend\\"><div class=\\"dvf-trend-label\\">" + type + "</div><div class=\\"dvf-bars\\">" + bars + "</div></div>";\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Prix m² médian (€) par année</h4>\' +\n',
      '    trendBar("Appartement") + trendBar("Maison") + \'</div>\';\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: map-dvf
if (dvf_ready) {
  st_dvf <- list(breaks = dvf_breaks[[TYPE_DEFAULT]], zero = FALSE)
  m <- cmap_choropleth(
    com_metro_only, dep_metro, dvf_default_year |> dplyr::rename(value = prix_m2_median),
    palette = PAL$green, legend_title = paste0("Prix médian au m² · ", TYPE_DEFAULT, " ", YEAR_DEFAULT),
    unit = "€/m²", digits = 0L, breaks = st_dvf,
    na_label = "Moins de 5 ventes ou non publié",
    note = "Seuils : quintiles 2021-2025 du type de bien.",
    tip_extra = function(j) ifelse(is.na(j$n_transactions), "",
                                   paste0(" · ", j$n_transactions, " ventes")))
  cmap_on_render(m, paste0("
    window.dvfMap = self;
    CMap.pick(self, function (code) {
      if (window.updateDvfPanel) window.updateDvfPanel(code);
      CMap.ctx.append('dvf-content', code, [
        { f: 'dvf_prix_mai', label: 'Prix m\u00b2 maison', unit: '\u20ac/m\u00b2', d: 0 },
        { f: 'dvf_prix_app', label: 'Prix m\u00b2 appartement', unit: '\u20ac/m\u00b2', d: 0 }
      ], 'Rep\u00e8res : rang centile (millésime le plus récent)');
    });
    var EVO_CATS = ['baisse de plus de 15 %', 'baisse de 5 \u00e0 15 %', 'stable (\u00b15 %)', 'hausse de 5 \u00e0 15 %', 'hausse de plus de 15 %'];
    window.dvfApply = function () {
      var y = document.querySelector('input[name=dvf-year]:checked');
      var t = document.querySelector('input[name=dvf-type]:checked');
      var md = document.querySelector('input[name=dvf-mode]:checked');
      var year = y ? +y.value : 2024, type = t ? t.value : 'Maison', evo = md && md.value === 'evo';
      var r21 = document.querySelector('input[name=dvf-year][value=\"2021\"]');
      if (r21) { r21.disabled = evo; if (evo && r21.checked) { var r24 = document.querySelector('input[name=dvf-year][value=\"2024\"]'); if (r24) { r24.checked = true; year = 2024; } } }
      function ent(c, yy) { var e = window.dvfData[c]; return e && e[type] && e[type][yy]; }
      var prov = year === 2025 ? ' (provisoire)' : '';
      if (evo) {
        function chg(c) { var a = ent(c, 2021), b = ent(c, year); return (a && b && a.pm > 0) ? (b.pm / a.pm - 1) * 100 : null; }
        CMap.recolor({
          get: chg,
          tip: function (c, v) { var a = ent(c, 2021), b = ent(c, year);
            return v == null ? 'Non calculable (moins de 5 ventes en 2021 ou ' + year + ')' :
              (v > 0 ? '+' : '') + CMap.fmt(v, 1) + '\u00a0% \u00b7 ' + CMap.fmt(a.pm, 0) + ' \u2192 ' + CMap.fmt(b.pm, 0) + '\u00a0\u20ac/m\u00b2'; },
          opacityOf: function (c) { var a = ent(c, 2021), b = ent(c, year); return (a && b && Math.min(a.n, b.n) < 10) ? 0.45 : 0.9; },
          palette: window.dvfDiv, breaks: [-1000, -15, -5, 5, 15, 1000],
          legend: { title: 'Évolution du prix médian \u00b7 ' + type + ' 2021\u2192' + year + prov, unit: '%', digits: 1, cats: EVO_CATS,
                    naLabel: 'Moins de 5 ventes en 2021 ou ' + year,
                    note: 'Variation nominale (non corrigée de l\u2019inflation). Teinte estompée : moins de 10 ventes sur l\u2019une des deux années.' }
        });
        return;
      }
      CMap.recolor({
        get: function (c) { var e = ent(c, year); return e ? e.pm : null; },
        tip: function (c, v) { var e = ent(c, year); return v == null ? 'Non publié (moins de 5 ventes)' :
          CMap.fmt(v, 0) + '\u00a0\u20ac/m\u00b2 \u00b7 ' + e.n + ' ventes'; },
        palette: window.dvfPalette, breaks: window.dvfBreaks[type],
        legend: { title: 'Prix médian au m\u00b2 \u00b7 ' + type + ' ' + year + prov, unit: '\u20ac/m\u00b2', digits: 0,
                  naLabel: 'Moins de 5 ventes ou non publié',
                  note: 'Seuils : quintiles 2021-2025 du type de bien.' }
      });
    };
    CMap.onRadios('dvf-year', window.dvfApply);
    CMap.onRadios('dvf-type', window.dvfApply);
    CMap.onRadios('dvf-mode', window.dvfApply);
    self.on('cmap:ready', window.dvfApply);
  "))
} else {
  htmltools::HTML("<p class='js-loading'>DVF non chargé. Lancer <code>Rscript scripts/03_dvf_aggregate.R</code>.</p>")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: drom-dvf-prep
#| include: false
if (dvf_ready) {
  dvf_drom_vals <- dvf |>
    dplyr::filter(annee == YEAR_DEFAULT, type_local == TYPE_DEFAULT,
                  !estimation_insuffisante) |>
    dplyr::transmute(code_commune, value = prix_m2_median)
}
```
